statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-33634 is a supply chain compromise that affected only the upstream aquasecurity/trivy v0.69.4 release published on 2026-03-19. The CVE description explicitly identifies versions 0.69.2 and 0.69.3 of the Trivy binary as known-safe. The DHI alpine variant ships trivy 0.70.0, which was tagged and built from the rebuilt upstream source after the incident with rotated credentials and is not the malicious v0.69.4 artifact. The DHI debian variants build trivy 0.69.3 from source with COMMIT_SHA verification (commit 6fb20c8edd70745d6b34bff0387b53b03c8a760a) and never pull the upstream prebuilt binary; this scanner false positive does not affect them. The advisory range >=0.69.4 with no fixed version is overly broad relative to the actual incident scope.
